title: Canonical prefix from a successful scan
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, and let $\alpha$ and $\mathrm{tail}$ be Boolean words. If scanning $\alpha$ succeeds and returns $\mathrm{tail}$, then removing all trailing $1$s from $\alpha$ gives the serialization of the code obtained by decoding $\alpha$.
